description: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary leader to oversee all operational aspects, ensuring the delivery of high-quality patient care and maintaining regulatory compliance.The ideal candidate will be responsible for fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff, driving continuous improvement in services, and managing financial performance. This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact within a dedicated team committed to excellence in rehabilitation services.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated success in operational management, financial oversight, and staff development.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, based on experience.
